name: Tozed Kangwei Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Tozed Kangwei Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures communication equipment and system solutions for telecom operators and industry customers. The company's products include wireless and wired broadband access products, such as 5G/4G CPE, MIFI, dongle, uninterruptible gateways, industrial routers, PONs, Wi-Fi routers, and fixed-mobile convergence terminals. The company offers FWA, such as fixed wireless phone; GPON/Wi-Fi, such as ONU FTTR, and Wi-Fi router; IoTs, such as industrial router, self-help terminal, car networking, GPS locator, and 4G (solar) camera; satellite direct connection terminal; and cloud laptop.
